triples.subject: AdaptationPathway
triples.context: We target the complementary problem of learning long-horizon, fine-grained adaptation pathways that couple hazard evolution with infrastructure-system impacts.

triples.subject: IntegratedAssessmentModel
triples.context: Integrated assessment models (IAMs) couple representations of the climate system with human and technological systems (e.g., energy, land use, macroeconomy) to explore long-run consequences of alternative assumptions and policy choices.

triples.subject: MachineLearning
triples.context: A growing literature therefore uses AI and machine learning (ML) to increase the accessibility and decision-relevance of IAMs.

triples.subject: Emulator
triples.context: One line of work builds emulators (surrogates) that approximate IAM behavior at a fraction of the computational cost, enabling rapid exploration of scenario spaces and sensitivity analyses.

triples.subject: ArtificialIntelligence
triples.context: Beyond acceleration, AI methods support (i) calibration and uncertainty analysis of high-dimensional model components, and (ii) closed-loop decision support, where policies are optimized against long-horizon, uncertain dynamics.
